evals.prompt: Set up the Task Management UI: a new React app using Vite, the TypeScript variant, and ESLint as the linter. Start with a login page that has a username and password field, where the username field only accepts an email address. The backend is the ASP.NET API in C:\Work\Tast_Management_System\Api, login goes through its AuthController.
evals.expected_output: Vite react-ts app with ESLint (not Oxlint), lint+build clean, login page posting {username,password} to /api/auth/login, email-only username enforced client-side, CORS/proxy handled, token stored.
assertions: Vite + React + TypeScript project (vite, react, typescript deps; tsconfig; src/main.tsx)
ESLint is the linter (eslint dep, eslint.config.*, lint script runs eslint, no oxlint)
npm run lint passes with no errors
npm run build (tsc -b + vite build) passes
Username input uses type="email"
Client-side email validation before submitting (pattern/validator in code)
Whitespace is stripped or trimmed from the username input
Username limited to 256 characters (matches API validator)
Login POSTs to /api/auth/login
Dev setup avoids the API CORS mismatch (Vite /api proxy, or https on :5173)
Access token from the response is kept and sent as a Bearer header
Handles 401 / invalid credentials with a message
